06 / Approaches / three plan insets and profiles

6A Abbey: world X −70…115, Y −305…−70 m, 40 m scale bar. 6B gorge/Foundry: X 30…245, Y −125…15 m, 50 m scale bar. 6C ridge/Court: X 110…330, Y −85…330 m, 50 m scale bar. All three plan insets are north up and share regional world XY; their page scales differ. The lower panels are route-distance/Z profiles, not extra map extents. The Abbey inlet/crossing extends from A1 (0,−265) through refuge A2 (16,−275) to A3 (30,−284).

Unresolved geography

The tomb interior has no surveyed transform into the rescue rim coordinates. The regional source ends at the three dungeon plans; treasury/finale dimensions are absent. GC10 provides a proposed post-reveal threshold only. No tomb, treasury or finale footprint is invented.

Historical village perspective and the oblique world concept are context, not metric sheets. The active PR27 implementation has its own acceptance evidence and is untouched.
